title: Expand Powers under Mental Health Act to Allow for Intervention when Relatives Do Not Allow Patients To Receive Treatment
what_it_is: Expand Powers under Mental Health Act to Allow for Intervention when Relatives Do Not Allow Patients To Receive Treatment

sections.label: Mental Health Care and Treatment Act
sections.summary: The MHCTA allows state intervention for persons with or suspected of mental health conditions who may be a risk to self or danger to others.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The Mental Health (Care and Treatment) Act or MHCTA allows for the state to intervene for persons with or suspected of having mental health conditions and who may be a risk to self or pose a danger to others.

sections.label: AIC community outreach teams
sections.summary: AIC set up 43 community outreach teams and trained over 24,000 frontline staff as of end 2019, reaching over 300,000 persons.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: To actively reach out to community to provide early identification and community support for persons with mental health needs, AIC has set up 43 community outreach teams and trained over 24,000 frontline staff from Government agencies and community partners across Singapore as of end 2019.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: These teams have reached out to over 300,000 persons and provided assistance to more than 23,000 persons who were at risk of developing mental health conditions or dementia.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: MOH is currently reviewing the enablers for the community support required which include the current legislative levers.

sections.label: Community Mental Health Master Plan
sections.summary: In 2012 MOH launched the Community Mental Health Master Plan to strengthen community mental health care and support persons with mental health needs.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: In 2012, MOH launched the Community Mental Health (CMH) Master Plan to further strengthen mental health care in the community and enable persons with mental health needs to be well supported.

sections.label: Support and polyclinic services
sections.summary: As of end 2019 over 26,000 persons were supported, and mental health and dementia services started in more than half of polyclinics.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: As of end 2019, over 26,000 persons had been supported by these teams.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: We have also started mental health and dementia services in more than half of our polyclinics and trained over 210 GP partners to diagnose and support persons with mental health conditions.

sections.label: Review of community support enablers
sections.summary: MOH is reviewing enablers for community support and will consider the Member's feedback and assess appropriate approaches and recourse.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: As I have mentioned, MOH is already reviewing the enablers for the community support.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: We will take the Member's feedback and input into consideration during this review and assess the appropriate approaches and recourse that we can take to address such cases in the community.
